description: Identify FF-to-FF segments with deep combinational logic for register retiming insertion. READ-ONLY. Use before execute_register_retiming. Trigger: WNS stuck, critical paths have deep combinational chains (>2 LUTs between FFs).

critical_paths.description: List of path dicts from Vivado extract_critical_path_pins. Each dict has 'pin_paths' key with pin path strings.

delay_threshold.description: Minimum combinational delay (ns) to flag a segment.

min_chain_depth.description: Minimum LUT chain depth to consider.
